1. The present application has been filed seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.
2.

By way of present appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgement of conviction dated 06.01.2023 and order on sentence dated 26.05.2023 vide which he has been directed to undergo RI for a period of 10 year for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC.
He was further sentenced to undergo SI for 4 years for the offence punishable under Section 366 IPC.
The benefit of Section 428 Cr.P.C. has also been provided to the appellant, and all the sentences have been directed to run concurrently.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the appellant/applicant submits that though the prosecution has relied upon the FSL report to support its case, however, the same cannot be considered, since the appellant was medically

sentences.text: 4. The application is resisted by the learned APP for the State, duly assisted by learned counsel appearing for the victim, states that the testimony of victim finds support in the MLC where the hymen was found to be 'not intact'.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record placed before me.
The evidence on record.

The contentions raised would require detailed analysis, however, for the present, the nominal roll dated 29.07.2025 of the appellant is on record according to which the appellant has undergone sentence of about 7 years including remission.
His jail conduct is stated to be satisfactory.
The appellant was earlier released on interim suspension of sentence for a period of 3 weeks from 11.04.2025 to 01.05.2025 whereafter he had surrendered in time.

6. Keeping in view the import of decisions and the fact that the hearing of the appeal will take some time, the sentence of the appellant/applicant is suspended during the pendency of the appeal on his furnishing of a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/ Duty J.M./ link J.M./Jail Superintendent and also subject to the further following conditions:-
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 02/09/2025 at 22:46:47 (i) In case of change of residential address, the appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Investigating Officer as well as to this Court.
(ii) The appellant shall regularly appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing.
(iii) The appellant will not get in touch directly or indirectly with the victim.
(iv) The appellant shall also provider his contact number to the IO and shall remain available on that number.
7. With the above directions, the application is disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be communicated electronically forthwith to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
9. Copy of this order be also uploaded on the website forthwith.
